title: reflex file frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of reflexes/<slug>.md. scope is behavioral, architectural or tool:<host>; summary is the one line the reflex index carries. occasion, falsified-when (the falsification trigger) and revise (the revision step) are checked by the curation rules rather than required here, so their absence is reported as a finding naming the rule. x-proposal-required lists what a file under proposals/reflexes/ must carry instead of required.
